description: A manual voltage source with a latching button and a momentary one, both sending the same voltage from a single output

params.text: Sets the voltage the buttons send, -10V to +10V, shown on the display
Holds the output at the set voltage until it is pressed again
Sends the set voltage for 1ms, and does nothing while the latch is holding

inputs.text: A trigger here latches the output on, and a second trigger latches it off

outputs.text: Carries the set voltage while the latch is on, and a 1ms burst of it when the momentary button is pressed

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
